facts.fact: 两尊护门石狮配合扑倒最近的一匹马。
facts.anchor: The guardian lions pounced, working as a pair to bring down the nearest horse.

facts.fact: 她把一道符贴到那匹长着三只眼的公马额头上。
facts.anchor: attaching a fu to the stallion’s forehead where three eyes glared at her

facts.fact: 黄符定住了兽，却随即像香一样慢慢烧尽。
facts.anchor: The yellow paper stopped the beast, but then began to slowly burn up, like a joss stick.

facts.fact: 长角的马跳过围栏，低头冲进人群，把人冲散。
facts.anchor: The antlered horse had jumped the barrier, sending the crowd scattering as it lowered its head and ploughed into their midst.

facts.fact: 长着皮革翅膀的那一匹飞上天空，落在看台上。
facts.anchor: The one with leathery wings had taken to the sky, landing in the grandstand.

facts.fact: 她让骑师们把红线缠在围栏上，说这样能把兽圈住。
facts.anchor: “Wind it around the fences, it’ll keep them in!”

facts.fact: 石狮急停把她从背上摔下来，靠反应和 qi 才没摔断骨头，四肢摊地。
facts.anchor: Only her reflexes and qi saved her from breaking every bone in her body, landing in a deep sprawl on all fours.

facts.fact: 符本是用来制 geongsi 之类邪物的，不是给石像用的。
facts.anchor: The fu were designed to control geongsi and other malevolent beings, not statues.

facts.fact: 老妇人守着受伤的男人，用合着的阳伞打兽的嘴脸，骂它别碰她的 George。
facts.anchor: “Get away from my George, you filthy scoundrel!”

facts.fact: 她把伞撑开，鼓起的伞面让马妖措手不及。
facts.anchor: The ballooning shape caught the horse demon by surprise

facts.fact: 她的符快用完了，袋里只剩两张。
facts.anchor: She was running low. Her pouch only had two talisman slips left.

facts.fact: 老妇人把伤员扶下楼梯，随后问她们能做什么。
facts.anchor: “What can we do?”

facts.fact: 她让老妇人把最后一卷线尽量多地缠在柱子之间。
facts.anchor: “Wrap it between the pillars, as many times as you can.

facts.fact: 有人朝飞马开枪，一发正中两眼之间。
facts.anchor: A revolver fired, one round square between the beast’s eyes

facts.fact: 六颗铅弹从它皮里掉出来，叮当落在木地板上。
facts.anchor: six metal pellets dropped from its skin, clattering onto the wooden floor

facts.fact: 她借那一瞬跃起，用 qi 把自己送到妖马背上。
facts.anchor: Kiamling used the moment to leap, qi boosting her across the expanse of air onto the demon horse’s back.

facts.fact: 她脚下的楼板塌了，她搂住石狮的脖子才没掉下去。
facts.anchor: The floorboards beneath her gave way

facts.fact: Bowring 装作没听见她的指挥，转过身去。
facts.anchor: Bowring gave her a perplexed look and then turned his back, pretending not to have heard.

facts.fact: 祖母的声音从脉动的红线之间一个字一个字地挤出来骂她。
facts.anchor: From between the pulsing red threads, a word at a time, her grandmother criticised her.

facts.fact: 她照祖母的吩咐关门，哪怕这等于当着祖母的面把门摔上。
facts.anchor: even though that had meant slamming the door in her grandmother’s face
